why: Same gap as Dallas/Detroit (threads#45): ES headlines name the team the way fans say it ('Ravens', 'Bills', 'LSU', 'JGR'), not the full registered phrase, so real team articles were rejected NO_NAMED_ENTITY. Each keyword checked against a month of ES headlines in its own category for collisions (Aug 25-Sep 25): bills 42 hits/0, ravens 34/0, lsu 108/0, ohio state 97/0, jgr 19/0, joe gibbs 12/0, hendrick 15/0, hms 10/0. Bare 'georgia' collided with Georgia Tech 5/19, so only 'georgia football' is added. Dale Earnhardt Sr. -> Dale Earnhardt Sr matches the real WP tag (471 articles); the trailing period made tag lookup fail, so the page's most-covered legend got no ES sourcing.
